en: Coming to Terms
Find the Frightened Paladin in Deathknell.

Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened paladin who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.

Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.
Continue Your Training
Follow the road east out of Deathknell to find the town of Brill. Report to Shari Stilwell to continue your training.

Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a paladin traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.

Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
A Second Home
Find the fortress of Bandarion Keep and report to Breton Samuels there.

It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new paladin order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
Another fresh recruit? Welcome to Bandarion Keep, brother.
Murlocs at the Gates
Slay $1oa Vile Fin Attackers and $2oa Vile Fin Seers and report back to Breton Samuels when it is done.

Normally we'd show our newcomers a bit more hospitality, but we've got a bit of a murloc problem at the moment.

A tribe of murlocs used to use the keep as their spawning grounds. They've been a problem since we moved in and kicked them out, but now it's starting to get out of hand. You look like you've seen some action. Do you think you could help us drive back some of these pests? You'll find them lurking in the bluffs along the road to the east, and in the camps around the lake to the west.

We appreciate the assistance. I'm sure this won't stop the attacks entirely, but it'll hopefully slow them down a bit. It's hard enough rebuilding this place without a murloc trying to stab you in the back with a spear.
Touring the Grounds
Speak to the residents of Bandarion Keep.

Now that the immediate threat of the murloc attacks is under control, I'd encourage you to show yourself around our stronghold. It isn't much yet, but it's home.

When you are done exploring, seek out Danitha Morr, our leader. She can help you get settled in.

I'm very glad to have met you, $n. May the light be your guide.

Breton sent you up here, eh? Excellent.

My name is Danitha Morr, and I am the closest thing this keep has to a commander. If you come seeking fellowship amongst those that still remain loyal to the light, you've come to the right place.

There's a lot of work to do here before we can fully establish ourselves, and we'd be most appreciative if you would be willing to lend aid.
Making Repairs
Collect 12 pieces of Sturdy Lumber from Shadowvale in Tirisfal Glades.

This far from the Undercity, logistics are challenging and we have a dire shortage of building materials needed to help restore this fortress. I'd like your help with that.

The ruined village of Shadowvale can be found in the Whispering Forest, just southwest of here. One of the buildings has an old root cellar used to store all sorts of things. There are likely to be usable materials down there. Scavenge what you can and return to us.

They say location is everything. While this fortress may look imposing perched upon these bluffs, it's turning out to be quite the challenge to stay supplied this far from proper civilization. An unfortunate oversight on our part.

I'm glad to see that your trip to Shadowvale bore fruit. I'll send Breton and a few of the other new recruits over later to clear the rest of the cellar out and retrieve anything left down in the dark.
The Tarnished
Slay 8 Tarnished Drudges, 6 Tarnished Zealots, and collect the head of Commander Rudolph Gelhardt in Tirisfal Glades.

Not all risen paladins have acclimated well to our new existence, as you may have seen yourself already. Some have carried forward their prejudices from life, and continue to visit violence upon their fellow Forsaken.

As it stands we are mistrusted by our people who remember well the persecution inflicted by the living in the name of the light, and these attacks do not help. A number of these tarnished have taken up residence at Shadowvale to the southwest. End them and bring me their leader's head.

The Tarnished threaten what little goodwill we have with the other Forsaken. As much as it pains me to cross blades with our former brothers and sisters, they must be stopped if our fledgling order is to survive.

Excellent work, $N. Every time one of these Tarnished strike out and kill one of the Forsaken, it becomes that much easier for our detractors to stoke mistrust towards us paladins. Eliminating them will help further our cause and solidify our place here in Tirisfal.

I suspect it may take a long time for us to be fully embraced by the Forsaken and the horde. It could take years... or maybe even decades, but the best we can do is keep trying to prove ourselves.
Home on the Range
Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.

During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
Seals of the Sin'dorei
Bring the Seal of the Warden, Seal of the Warrior, and Seal of the Ranger to the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.

<The seal of the first crystal bears the mark of a sword. Its energy must be channeled by an expert warrior.

The seal of the middle crystal bears the mark of a glaive. Its energy must be channeled by one of both martial and magical prowess.

The seal of the last crystal bears the mark of a talon. Its energy must be channeled by one at home in the wilds.

It's likely that some of Rimtori's officers are carrying these seals to aid her in the spell. Taking them would no doubt be troublesome for her.>
An Explosive Gambit
Break the Seals of the Sin'dorei, then bring Magus Rimtori's head to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok.

<Seeing how the energies of the crystals are attuned to the seals, you reason that destroying a seal, thereby releasing its energy all at once, could cause its crystal to do the same.

The explosive results would certainly draw Rimtori's ire. It would also present the perfect opportunity to attack her while she's flustered.>
Revenge Exacted
Bring the Head of Magus Rimtori to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.
Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself!$B$BAh, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, $n.
Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
Bring the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning back to Jediga in Valormok.

Rimtori's tome still sits atop its pedestal. Who knows what secrets its pages could hold? 

Perhaps it would be best not to leave such a powerful artifact out here in the wilds.
Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning
Bring the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning to Zevrost in Orgrimmar.

You were wise to take this, $n. More than killing Rimtori, keeping this out of the blood elves' hands will ensure they are powerless to retaliate against us.

As for deciphering the tome itself, I have a contact in Orgrimmar who dabbles in such things--a warlock named Zevrost. He can be found in the Cleft of Shadow.
Vek'zol
Use the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning to summon Vek'zol at the Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Bring the Heart of Vek'zol to Zevrost in Orgrimmar.

I do not speak Thalassian, but these diagrams are familiar to me.

Knowing the blood elves' addiction to mana, I'd say they were trying to summon demons to drain them of their fel magic.

Simply consuming such powerful energy is a waste. We could harness it for a much greater purpose.

<Zevrost bookmarks a page in the tome>

There is an Altar of Storms in the Blasted Lands. Perform this ritual there to summon the demon Vek'zol. His heart will make a potent reagent. Think of the power we could have!
Itching for a Fixing
Bring $1oa Mithril Casings and $2oa Mechanical Repair Kit to Hnaz Blunderflame.

We've been stuck here for five years, and we've had to build everything from scratch! Do you know how much I've had to improvise just to do any engineering?

Hey, if you can help me out with some materials, I can make it worth your time! Build me a couple of Mithril Casings and a Mechanical Repair Kit so that I can fix up some stuff, and I'll show you a few things I've figured out.
Long Walks on the Beach
Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.

What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!
Blue Gold
Bring a Mana-Siphoning Wand to Izvi Gildfizz at Valormok.

Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!
Pay Dirt!
Find someone to appraise the Humongous Crystal.

<The large hunk of crystal is even heavier than it looks. While it appears to be quite the prize, its true nature is unknown to you. Someone with an eye for valuables could say what you've really found.>
Gettin' Buzzed
Gather $1oa Wild Honey from Wasp Nests using Kurll's Pellet Gun.

There are few luxuries out here on the frontier. A barrel of good drink would surely boost the camp's morale.

In my younger days, I took a recipe for a delicious brew off the corpse of a dwarf I killed. All I need is some honey. Fortunately, the wasp nests to the west are overflowing with it.

Take my pellet gun. This will allow you to knock the nests out of the trees. Be warned, however, it will do little against the wasps themselves.
Winter Frontier Fishery
Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Kurll at Valormok.

Meat is well and good, but a varied diet makes the body stronger.

Winter squid are in season, and can be fished from the coasts here in Azshara. I never took to angling myself. I much prefer the safety of land. Although, were you to fish some up, or obtain them via some other means, I would greatly appreciate it.
Deadliest Catch
Bring a Mammoth Shark Steak to Kurll at Valormok.

If you wish for a true test of angling prowess, there are bigger fish than you can catch with a rod.

Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern and southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean.

They are massive creatures. I would advise you to bring a hunting party. 

If you do go after one, bring me a cut of the meat.
Ley of the Land
Use the Mana-Siphoning Wand on the Leyline Rift in Lake Mennar and bring the Tear of Mennar to Izvi Gildfizz.

When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff.

I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline.

If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich!

If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.
To the Summit of Eternity
Travel to the Summit of Eternity and speak with the druids about the survivor village.

You've managed to cut a swath through the undead that have kept us trapped here for so many years, and for that we can never repay you.

I have one more favor to ask, on behalf of us all. We know that there are druids at the summit. They protect Nordrassil and the Well of Eternity.

Why did they never come help us to escape?

For five years we have been trapped here. At last we have a glimmer of hope... but why didn't the druids come for us?

Let someone know that we're still alive!
Open Season
Escort the Barkskin Matriarch out of Deadwood Den and return to Barkskin Burrow.

Deadwood set on my pup and his sire. He stood fast, fought to the death as our guard. We must go home, but the way is dark and full of jaws.

Stay near, guard us well. I will lead, you will fend, and we will see den safe.
Meet the Elders
Find and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker within Barkskin Burrow.

Thank you for helping gather bear berries. Small steps build trust! With the aroma of berry resin on you, the Elders should be more welcoming of you. 

Go and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker.
Barkskin Breakout
Recover a Deadwood Key from a Deadwood Warden and return to the Barkskin Cage.

<A matriarchal furbolg speaks to you from within the cage>

"Deadwood trap me and my cub in tough cage. Key hang on Deadwood Warden belt. You hunt them, take key, lift latch, set us free. Do this, and Barkskin know your heart true."
Delicate Instruments
Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?
Let me know when you are finished, so I can try to calibrate my instruments again.
Well done, my friend. Let me try my calibrations again...
Delicate Instruments
Kill $1oa Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

Almost there, and... By the Nether! Something is still disrupting my instruments.

This is most frustrating, $n. I have heard rumors that the local bandits have been practicing spells near Stone Cairn Lake. Maybe if you stop them, these disruptions will finally cease and I can get some work done?
It seems like everything is working properly. Thank you, $N.
Stolen Enchanting Supplies
Collect 5 Stolen Enchanting Supplies from gnoll camps around Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Blixie Fitzwink near the Tower of Azora.

I was sent by Master Theocritus to pick up some enchanting supplies from the trading post, but on the way back I was ambushed by a pack of gnolls!

I dropped the package and escaped, but if I return without it, I'll be cleaning up after the polymorph experiments for weeks as punishment! Do you think you could find the supplies for me?
Did you find the supplies?
Oh, that's a relief! It looks like it's all here. Thank you!
Good Steel
Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?
Have you been to the mine yet?
Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
Downstream
Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
Did you find the supplies?
You look a bit damp, $N. Sorry about that. But thank you for retrieving the supplies.
Remote Contact
Speak to Jediga in Azshara.

<The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 

'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? 

Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ...

Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
Remote Contact
Speak to Jediga in Azshara.

Listen, $c, you'd best not be hangin' round here for long. But since you are, perhaps you can do a little favor for me?

I be expecting a certain something from a Jediga, in Azshara. She and some orcs be havin' a camp out there. Go and tell her Jes'rimon sent you, and I'll owe you one.
Applejack Still
A strong scent of apples burns your nose as you inspect the device.
The machine dispenses a clear liquid into a bottle...
Remote Contact
Speak to Jediga in Azshara.

My duties occasionally require reagents from the farther corners of Azeroth. However, I am always needed here in Thunder Bluff, and so I am in need of competent aides.

To that end, I am awaiting a delivery from an orc named Jediga, in Azshara. If you care to make yourself useful, find her camp, and inquire as to when I can expect it to arrive.
An Apple Treat
The sergeant's eyes light up as he notices your bottle of Thunder Applejack...
Do my eyes deceive me? I haven't seen a drop of Thunder Applejack in months!$B$BThis should put a smile on the troops' faces. You have my thanks, $C!
Croaky's Head
Deliver Croaky's Head to Merell Ross at Ridgepoint Tower.
This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.
Yes?
We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, $c. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
Nibbled-On Book
Return the book to Brother Paxton.

<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.

Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?
Rascally Rodents
Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.$B$BBut there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
Mining Consultant
Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.
Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.
Elmpaw's Head
Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
The trophy serves as an impressive reminder of your victory over Elmpaw. A local hunter or skinner might be interested to hear the story.
Yes?

So, you took down Elmpaw? Very impressive, $N!

Let me give you something in return for your trophy - I know a few collectors who will pay quite well to have this on their mantle once I've prepared it.
Rough Wolf Pelts
Skin wolves around Elwynn Forest to obtain $1oa Rough Wolf Pelts, then deliver them to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.

Are you looking for an opportunity to practice skinning? My husband usually helps with hunting wolves, but he's busy up by the abbey. I could use a hand collecting more pelts to finish the orders I'm working on.
Any luck with those wolf pelts?
Excellent work collecting these pelts, $c. You have a real talent for hunting.
The Big Picture
Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.
Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!
An Enchanting Lesson

Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue.

Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.

Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments.

Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
What have your studies revealed?
Theory and practice are two sides of a coin, $N. Remember this.
Rub Some Dirt In It
Collect $1oa samples of Untainted Soil from around the foothills of Mount Hyjal.

I haven't seen |5$r like you in years!

Oh, I don't know what to do! My friend Fraxinus is sick, and I can't leave him alone!

Could you please fetch me some Untainted Soil from the uncorrupted land southeast of here? I can make some poultices that may help him to feel better.
Leaves to Ligatures
Collect $1oa Verdant Leaves from Tainted Shrubbery in the foothills of Mount Hyjal.

Have you seen those nasty tainted shrubberies wandering around this valley?

Those plants are mean, but some of them are not entirely toxic. Their leaves can have medicinal purposes.

Would you be so kind as to fetch me some Verdant Leaves? You'll have to do a little pruning, of course.
Follow That Kobold!
Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new Hunter trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.
I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.
Bark Bite
Apply the poultice to Fraxinus.

With the ingredients you brought, I can make some simple medicine. This poultice should aid Fraxinus. He is old, you know, and he was badly burned during the wars. His bark hurts and his limbs ache. He is my best friend and I just want him to feel better!

Take this poultice and apply it liberally to all of the places where his bark is split and his sap is weeping.
Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.
Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
Book Return
Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!
Have you found all the books yet?

I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.

You can keep that book bag!
Rare Books
Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.
Have you found all my missing books yet?
Oh, $N! Thank you so much for saving my library. You've done me an amazing service. Please take one of these fine weapons. They were intended for the militia, but you can make better use of them.
Flags of Our Forebears
Collect $1oa Horde Flag and $2oa Scraps of Horde Heraldry for Kal'tinzan at Elderwild.

We been stuck up here for years, always fighting against de Scourge, but we never lose hope. We fight to survive. We fight for da Horde. Da Alliance shares dis fight, but we never forget dat we still got history. Still got blood.

Far to da east, at Dae'gun, dere are Horde flags from da war. Da demons carry scraps and remains as trophies from da battle, especially da tough ones. Bring me a flag and some heraldry so I can put it up and show da Alliance dat da Horde is still strong!
Diplomatic Incident
Travel to The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest and speak with Trevan Rol about the missing Earthen Ring travelers.

A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $c.
A Curious Pair
Speak with Deathguard Baldren about the mysterious Earthen Ring travelers who recently passed through The Sepulcher.

Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?
A Grim Fate
Investigate Fenris Isle to the east and learn the fate of the Earthen Ring traveling party.

Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.

<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
Into Fenris Keep
Investigate Fenris Keep to the north and attempt to locate the missing member of the Earthen Ring party.
<The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>

You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? 

Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
Lumina Windsinger
Retrieve the Fenris Isle Key from the Rot Hide Gnolls and use it to free Lumina Windsinger.

Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
Thank you, $c. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
Demon Hunter's Hunter
Find Maerion Thaelemaches somewhere on Mount Hyjal.

Not many demon hunters remain on Azeroth now, but a few of us continue to hunt the most dangerous or hidden threats.

A colleague of mine, Maerion Thaelemaches, headed to Hyjal to investigate rumors of demons there. While there are many demons in the dangerous Darkwhisper Gorge, there is suspicion that the demons that assaulted the mountain during the last war might not be completely defeated.

This bears investigation.
The Western Post
Meet Sefira Everbright at the outpost.

With the warlocks under control, I'd say this area's well in wing.

<The crow nods sagely, looking pleased.>

Though our work here is done, there are other areas that could use your help and as an underwing of mine I would like you to go see what all the fuss is about.

Follow the path northwest up the road to the old tern outpost. An old friend awaits!
The Grand Alliance
Search Mount Hyjal for remnants of the Grand Alliance.

Years ago, the Horde and the Alliance put aside their differences to fight a greater threat--the Legion. On Mount Hyjal, the Grand Alliance forces battled Archimonde and his minions to a halt.

The retreat from the mountain was perilous, however, and some brave fighters were left behind.

Now that the way up the great mountain is again open, perhaps some of these heroes remain alive in the wilds? Go to Mount Hyjal and brave its dangers. Find what became of our forces there.
Spear of the Skylord
Slay Zarrat Wormwing and return Omnuron's Spear.

While fighting off the Wormwing harpies I was brutally ambushed by a harpy named Zarrat who patrols this area. She snatched my spear and carried it off before I could recover. To what end she desired to possess it, I cannot say.

That spear has been in my family for generations and is of great importance to me. If you spot Zarrat among the harpies, slay her and return my spear. She is stealthy, and will not be easily found, but I would be grateful to have my spear returned.

Wild Eyes
Gather 3 murloc eyes and bring them to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.

I wouldn't dare to question the effectiveness of Apothecary Renferrel's formulae, however I would be lying if I said that the potion made any noticeable difference.

Along the shore of Lake Lordamere are a swarm of murlocs, and of note, murlocs have eyes. I suspect the apothecary's willingness to try new things is suppressed by his recent obsession with hearts. Bring him a few.

If my choice is to inevitably die a second death or have Renferrel kill me for questioning his methods, I choose the latter.
Oh. You're back?

The potion didn't work? Of course it didn't work. You brought me insufficient hearts. The recipe clearly calls for six. You brought three.

However, I confess I hadn't considered applications for murloc parts until now...

<Renferrel takes the eyes.>

I can afford to sacrifice a few of my own hearts to get your Deathstalker's strength back.
Return to Quinn (Again)
Bring Quinn's potion to Quinn Yorick at the Ivar Patch, north of the Sepulcher.

Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts.

Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.

<Quinn takes the potion and drinks it.>

Yes, I can feel it working.  I will soon be able to travel.

You have done me a great favor, $N.
Celastrus the Bitter
Find and destroy Celastrus the Bitter, and return to Thylaen with its broken frond.

The mountain is overrun with wild growth, inflamed by the fel energies that rained down so long ago. Now the weeds and plants are angry, corrupted, poisoned.

There is a great thorn-bush called Celastrus that lurks about the slopes to the east. It kills animals, lashes out at other plants, feeds on the bodies of the dead. It must be destroyed!

The weeds must be cleared so that the mountain may regrow.
The Source of the Corruption
Find the hermit Ketharas on Mount Hyjal.

So much corruption rains down into Felwood from above. When the waters run high from Hyjal, they are filled with fel taint. It soaks into the ground and diseases the trees and plants.

There was a druid who lived in the wild, a hermit named Ketharas, who had a deep knowledge of the mountain. If anyone knows what has happened on Hyjal, it is he.

I think that Felwood cannot heal until the problem on Hyjal is resolved.
